{{Top}}
'''Basalt''' was a black volcanic rock. 

''[[Star Home]]'', the personal transport vessel of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]], was built directly on a large chunk of wind-sculpted black basalt mined from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
